thread:
amy_sales: Heads up — GovHealth POC is moving to signature. Need quick alignment on MSA+DPA redlines, PO routing, and KMS questions. PO draft below.

devon_se: Scope for POC = 2-week eval, 3 seats, dedicated capacity. They asked about HIPAA / BAA and data residency (GovCloud).

claire_procure: Procurement here — we'll need the signed PO + vendor W9 and insurance cert. What payment terms do they want?

amy_sales: PO snippet: `PO#: GOV-PO-4591; Amount: $45,000; Term: 90 days (covers POC)`. Customer mentioned net45 in their process.

ben_legal: Can you share the draft MSA/DPA? Main legal asks: narrow indemnity, cap liability for processor, list approved subprocessors or delegation process, and include exit assistance in DPA. I can put together a redline by EOD.

fred_ops: For KMS: customer wants customer-managed keys in GovCloud. We support AWS KMS in GovCloud for envelope keys, but full key import isn't supported on our current stack. Will confirm exact constraints.

amy_sales: They also want to confirm signature routing — finance + legal on their side. On our side they want countersignature from Redwood. Preferred via DocuSign.

claire_procure: If DocuSign, route to `finance@redwood.com` and `legal@redwood.com`. Remit/invoice address needed: Redwood Inference, 123 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105.

monica_renewals: Also flag: if this converts to production, we should avoid auto-renew language in the POC order. Make renewal terms explicit later.

ben_legal: Redline notes (high level): no unlimited subprocessors, add approval list; narrow data processor liability; decline broad export control indemnity; SLA not required for POC but include a "best efforts" availability commitment. I'll upload the tracked changes.

fred_ops: Quick note for the team — envelope-level KMS import is not supported in GovCloud on our infra; we can offer envelope encryption with customer-managed AWS KMS keys (customer retains key control). I'll follow up with a short tech note.

amy_sales: Uploading security questionnaire link from the customer: https://forms.government/govhealth-sec. They asked for SOC2 evidence and KMS details.

ben_legal: Uploaded redline here: https://redwood.work/docs/redlines/govhealth-msadpa-2019876543. Inline comments on subprocessors, liability caps, and signature block.

docbot: DocuSign envelope GOV-PO-4591 created by amy_sales; routing -> legal@redwood.com, finance@redwood.com.

amy_sales: @blake_customer can you confirm your finance sig path and whether PO will be attached in DocuSign or sent separately? :slightly_smiling_face:

blake_customer: Finance will sign via DocuSign. PO attached and routing looks good. Expect signatures by EOD tomorrow.

amy_sales: Great, thanks — once legal posts final redline I'll send the DocuSign and confirm KMS note with Ops.

ben_legal: FYI I'll be offline after 18:00 PT. If anything blocks signing, ping me and I'll respond asap.

fred_ops: I'll draft the KMS tech note and post here within the hour.

claire_procure: I'll prepare vendor packet (W9, insurance, references) to send once MSA/DPA redlines are agreed.

amy_sales: Thanks team — moving to actions: Ben (redline) / Fred (KMS note) / Claire (vendor packet). I'll coordinate DocuSign once done. :thumbsup:
